semiconductor_relevance: High — SiScan Technology specializes in E-beam metrology and inspection equipment, which are critical for semiconductor wafer fabrication.
summary: SiScan Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on providing advanced electron beam imaging technologies for patterned wafer metrology and inspection. Established in 2021, the company aims to deliver high-end solutions that address bottlenecks in semiconductor manufacturing equipment localization.

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Suzhou, within the Xiangcheng District Economic Development Zone.
